description: This file implements a client-side communication interface for a remote proxy system, including classes for proxy objects and a client class for socket communication with a server, handling remote method calls, parameter access, and message serialization.

classes.name: ClientProxyObject
classes.description: Proxy object representing remote objects, enabling method calls and attribute access transparently.

classes.name: BlivetGUIClient
classes.description: Client class managing socket communication with server, handling remote method invocation, parameter access, and message serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: ClientProxyObject.__init__
methods.description: Initializes proxy object with client reference and proxy ID.

methods.name: BlivetGUIClient.__init__
methods.description: Initializes client, connects socket, and sets up mutex.

methods.name: BlivetGUIClient._answer_convertTo_object
methods.description: Converts server answer to local object, creating proxies as needed.

methods.name: BlivetGUIClient._args_convertTo_id
methods.description: Converts arguments to IDs for remote calls.

methods.name: BlivetGUIClient.remote_next
methods.description: Gets next item from remote iterable.

methods.name: BlivetGUIClient.remote_do_it
methods.description: Executes a remote 'do it' command with progress callback.

methods.name: BlivetGUIClient._recv_msg
methods.description: Receives message from server, first 4 bytes indicate length.

methods.name: BlivetGUIClient._recv_data
methods.description: Receives specified length of data from socket.

methods.name: BlivetGUIClient._send
methods.description: Sends data over socket with length prefix.
